pulse-servo.source:
void setup(){Serial.begin(115200);pinMode(9,OUTPUT);}
void loop(){unsigned int widths[3]={600,1500,2300};unsigned int width=widths[(millis()/1000)%3];digitalWrite(9,HIGH);delayMicroseconds(width);digitalWrite(9,LOW);delayMicroseconds(10000-width);delayMicroseconds(10000);Serial.print("PULSE=");Serial.println(width);}

digital-hx711.source:
void setup(){Serial.begin(115200);pinMode(3,OUTPUT);digitalWrite(3,LOW);pinMode(2,INPUT);}
void loop(){unsigned long deadline=millis()+1000;while(digitalRead(2)&&millis()<deadline){}if(digitalRead(2)){Serial.println("HX timeout");return;}uint32_t raw=0;noInterrupts();for(uint8_t i=0;i<24;i++){digitalWrite(3,HIGH);delayMicroseconds(1);raw=(raw<<1)|digitalRead(2);digitalWrite(3,LOW);delayMicroseconds(1);}digitalWrite(3,HIGH);delayMicroseconds(1);digitalWrite(3,LOW);interrupts();if(raw&0x800000)raw|=0xff000000;Serial.print("HX A128=");Serial.println((int32_t)raw);delay(20);}

actuator-ws2812.source:
void byteOut(uint8_t b){asm volatile(".rept 8
	 sbi %1,6
	 nop
	 sbrs %0,7
	 cbi %1,6
	 .rept 7
	 nop
	 .endr
	 cbi %1,6
	 .rept 4
	 nop
	 .endr
	 lsl %0
	 .endr":"+r"(b):"I"(_SFR_IO_ADDR(PORTD)));}
void setup(){pinMode(6,OUTPUT);Serial.begin(115200);}
void loop(){noInterrupts();for(uint8_t i=0;i<8;i++){byteOut(i*25);byteOut(255-i*25);byteOut(i*16);}interrupts();delayMicroseconds(80);Serial.println("WS2812 GRB frame");delay(100);}
